name: bed-exit-steady
description: A patient gets out of bed unaided and walks steadily to the door.

name: bed-exit-unsteady
description: The same exit, but the walk that follows is wide and irregular.

name: bed-exit-to-floor
description: The exit is not caught in time and the patient ends up on the floor.

name: settled-turning-over
description: A patient asleep in bed who turns over twice. No call should be raised.

name: visitor-in-chair
description: Someone sits in the chair and shifts position without getting up.

name: unsteady-walk
description: A patient crosses the room swaying widely with uneven steps.

name: curtain-drawn
description: A curtain is pulled across the lens while the patient is sitting up. The product must say it cannot see.
